title: REV-47: Extend one paid plugin operation beyond the one-guest envelope
body:
Roadmap row: REV-47. Source: [revenue roadmap](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/sales/revenue-roadmap.md).

## Problem and result

The shipped paid plugin path sells only one guest step requiring nothing, with an empty snapshot for snapshot-read. A specific paying requirement may need a richer bounded operation. Add one separately versioned packet/executor profile with exact disclosure, effects, fees, and partial-failure semantics while preserving existing releases’ grants.

## Sources and ownership

Follow `docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md`, `docs/extensions/plugins.md`, and `docs/api/2026-10-02-agentic-execution-router.md`. Reuse `crates/openagents-cli/src/pay_plugin.rs`, `crates/plugin/src/engine.rs`, `crates/x402/src/front.rs`, and `crates/pay-ledger`; verify these consumers before changing the supported profile.

## Scoped implementation

- Select one demonstrated richer operation and pin its new version, packet schema, inputs, outputs, source/recipient rights, resource bounds, and allowed effects.
- Admit exact quote, release, disclosure, current grants, and payer before payment/dispatch; keep networking and credentials in trusted Rust host owners.
- Retain step/delivery receipts, cancellation and partial-failure outcomes, retries/unknown effects, and complete fee/cost settlement.
- Refuse old releases under broader grants and expose unsupported richer operations as unavailable.

## Acceptance

A bounded fixture completes the selected richer operation under exact new terms. Unauthorized source/recipient/effect, substituted version, oversized packet, cancelled step, and partial failure produce truthful retained outcomes. Payment or dispatch replay creates no duplicate charge/effect; unknown execution is reconciled rather than rerun. Signed author fees and existing one-guest behavior remain correct.

## Dependencies

Mandatory: demonstrated customer need, [REV-11 (#10818)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10818), [REV-12 (#10819)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10819), and relevant admission/disclosure policy. Conditional: [REV-41 (#10848)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10848) for team rules and [REV-20 (#10828)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10828) for cross-product funding. Choose one richer profile; general workflow invocation, arbitrary network guests, and every future operation are outside scope.

## Validation

Run focused plugin ABI/engine, paid-route, x402, and ledger tests only for edited owners, including partial failure, cancel/restart, unsupported profile, quote changes, and conservation. Use isolated scratch state, synthetic identities, and fake services or wallets. Product behavior stays in Rust. Run `cargo fmt` and targeted tests for edited crates with the pinned toolchain and a reused external Cargo target directory; add no GitHub workflow or full release gate.

## Activation and closure

The owner qualifies the selected actual richer purchase and disclosure separately. Do not advertise a general executor, support an invented fee, or broaden an old customer grant through an upgraded runtime. Close after the scoped code and checks pass, merge to main, and any required host deploy completes. Record owner-only funds, credentials, permissions, commercial decisions, and external qualification in `NEEDS_OWNER.md`; they do not keep code-complete work open. A later qualification defect gets a focused new issue.

## Roadmap and dependency registration

Stable roadmap ID: **REV-47**. [Unified revenue roadmap](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/sales/revenue-roadmap.md#build-issue-list).

Native completion blockers: #10818, #10819

Roadmap dependency scope, including conditional branches and reused foundations: Demonstrated customer need; [REV-11 (#10818)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10818), [REV-12 (#10819)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10819), relevant policy

Conditional integration branches are implemented when enabled; alternatives select one product lane. A reused closed foundation, optional relay telemetry, or owner-only activation is not a new native completion blocker. Claim this issue before implementation and maintain the project status. Close after scoped code/artifacts, focused checks, merge to main, and any required host deploy are complete; record owner-only qualification/activation in `NEEDS_OWNER.md`.
